target.user-input: glyph-vpath: order maintenance, layer 3 of .plan section 0, as order queries over the positions the index holds

constraint.user-input: the order is the index own: files in the order the index lists them, then nodes by start, the one that holds the other first; it is computed once on load, and nothing new is stored
above answers the nodes of the same file that end where a node starts or before, nearest first; between answers every node from one reference to the other in order, across files
a reference is a virtual path, an alias, a recovery or a NodeID, read as resolve reads it, and one the index does not hold is refused

never.user-input: stable positions in the index, order labels by Dietz–Sleator and relative offsets: they would hold 42.0 percent of the rows an edit rewrites, under the 50 percent declared, INTAKE-VIRTUAL-PATH section 25

validate.user-input: for any two references, before answers which comes first, or that one holds the other, in constant time

above answers what precedes a node in its file, nearest first, and between the nodes from one reference to another in order, each by a search in logarithmic time; between refuses when the second comes first
the order agrees with the files and offsets of the index on every pair of the repository, and answers right after a node is inserted, moved or removed
